expectations.evidence: "+5V DC regulated — powers all digital logic"

expectations.text: The classic failure is the 5V regulator failing such that the 5V rail rises (overvoltage)
expectations.evidence: "5V regulator fails shorted... dumps the raw rectified input (~9–12V+ DC) straight onto the 5V rail"

expectations.text: The overvoltage damages chips (RAM and/or other ICs)
